responsibility: Declares the helper used to scan driver-level preprocessing options embedded in the overall command line. Its single exported routine identifies the `-fcpp-begin`/`-fcpp-end` region and records relevant cpp arguments for later reconstruction of the preprocessor invocation.
same_name_distinction: This definition module only advertises the `ScanCppArgs` entry point for driver-option scanning. The paired `M2DriverOptions.mod` contains the actual command-line walk between `-fcpp-begin` and `-fcpp-end` and the logic for remembering option arguments such as `-I`, `-D`, `-isystem`, and `-imultiarch`.
